[Books, documentation, tutorials and talks about the golemverse, gathered since 2019. The ecosystem keeps moving, so some of the oldest entries below may be out of date.]{.gv-lede}

## Books 📚

- ["Engineering Production-grade Shiny Apps"](https://engineering-shiny.org/) — the book behind the golemverse, by Colin Fay, Sébastien Rochette, Vincent Guyader and Cervan Girard. Free to read online, and in print in the R Series by Chapman and Hall/CRC.
- ["Shiny App-Packages"](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/shiny-app-pkgs/golem.html) — a whole chapter builds the same app with `{golem}`, by Martin Frigaard.
- ["Shiny Frameworks"](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/sfw/golem.html) — `{golem}`, `{leprechaun}` and `{rhino}` side by side, by Martin Frigaard.
- 🇧🇷 ["Programando em Shiny"](https://curso-r.github.io/programando-em-shiny/golem.html) — chapter 11 covers `{golem}` in Portuguese, by Curso-R.

## Documentation 📖

- [Getting started](https://thinkr-open.github.io/golem/articles/a-getting-started.html) — from `create_golem()` to a first working app.
- [Day to day development](https://thinkr-open.github.io/golem/articles/b-develop.html) — modules, functions, tests, the `dev/` scripts.
- [Deploy your app](https://thinkr-open.github.io/golem/articles/c-deploy.html) — Docker, `{renv}`, Posit Connect, shinyapps.io, ShinyProxy.
- [JavaScript](https://thinkr-open.github.io/golem/articles/d-js.html) and [configuration](https://thinkr-open.github.io/golem/articles/e-config.html).
- [Extending `{golem}`](https://thinkr-open.github.io/golem/articles/f-extending_golem.html) — write your own templates and hooks.
- [Test your app with Playwright](https://thinkr-open.github.io/pw/) — the `{pw}` package documentation.
- [golem agent skills](https://github.com/ThinkR-open/golem-agent-skills) — teach your coding assistant the golem conventions.

## Cheatsheet 📑

- [`{golem}` cheatsheet](https://rstudio.github.io/cheatsheets/golem.pdf), also in the [Posit cheatsheet gallery](https://posit.co/resources/cheatsheets/).

## Blog posts ✍️

For the latest news, read the [golemverse blog](/news/).

You can also browse the ["golem" tag](https://rtask.thinkr.fr/golem/) on the RTask website.

Written elsewhere in the community:

- ["{rhino} vs {golem} vs {leprechaun}: Which R/Shiny Library is Right for You?"](https://www.appsilon.com/post/rhino-vs-golem-vs-leprechaun) — Gift Kenneth, Appsilon, 2023.
- ["Navigating the Shiny Universe with Golem"](https://prof-thiagooliveira.netlify.app/post/golem-package/) — Thiago de Paula Oliveira, 2023.
- ["Deploying a Golem Shiny App to ShinyApps.io"](https://pacha.dev/blog/2025/08/24/golem/) — Mauricio Vargas Sepúlveda, 2025.
- [golemWebR](https://github.com/DivadNojnarg/golemWebR) — a worked example of a `{golem}` app served with webR, by David Granjon.

## Conferences, videos, podcasts 🤩

Have any resource to add here? [Feel free to open an issue!](https://github.com/ThinkR-open/golemverse.org/issues).

## Apps built with `{golem}` 🚀

A list of open-source applications built with `{golem}`, from research tools to NHS dashboards, is kept in the [package documentation](https://thinkr-open.github.io/golem/articles/h-resources.html).
